tasks.label: g++: build all (no cmake)
tasks.command: if not exist build mkdir build && g++ -std=c++17 -Iinclude -Wall -Wextra -g -c src/state.cpp -o build/state.o && g++ -std=c++17 -Iinclude -Wall -Wextra -g -c src/euler.cpp -o build/euler.o && g++ -std=c++17 -Iinclude -Wall -Wextra -g -c src/rk4.cpp -o build/rk4.o && g++ -std=c++17 -Iinclude -Wall -Wextra -g -c src/solver.cpp -o build/solver.o && g++ -std=c++17 -Iinclude -Wall -Wextra -g -c src/phase_line.cpp -o build/phase_line.o && g++ -std=c++17 -Iinclude -Wall -Wextra -g -c src/io.cpp -o build/io.o && g++ -std=c++17 -Iinclude -Wall -Wextra -g build/state.o build/euler.o build/rk4.o build/solver.o build/phase_line.o build/io.o apps/cli/main.cpp -o build/odelab_cli.exe && g++ -std=c++17 -Iinclude -Wall -Wextra -g build/state.o build/euler.o build/rk4.o build/solver.o build/phase_line.o build/io.o tests/test_core.cpp -o build/test_core.exe && g++ -std=c++17 -Iinclude -Wall -Wextra -g build/state.o build/euler.o build/rk4.o build/solver.o build/phase_line.o build/io.o tests/test_phase_line.cpp -o build/test_phase_line.exe
